gateResults.evidence: The final Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,639 total tests, 1,605 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; Search and representative suites also passed. Existing dependency, documentation, nullability and analyzer warnings remained outside the Search build, which passed with -warnaserror.

The separate review approved the complete stable-code inventory, host-boundary distinction, minimal repair matrix, raw-text preservation, wildcard-language separation and completeness boundary; the review artifact is retained with its tested hash.
Eight focused mutation tests cover all required repair classes against the actual Search schema/query runtime; the full Search suite and five registered semantic harnesses also passed.

The catalog's source names and constructor arguments are checked against SearchSchema behavior, while valid repaired queries execute with the intended result unit and invalid mutations fail at the expected boundary.

knownLimitations: Host compiler and planner diagnostics remain host-owned; the catalog records their actual type/contract boundary rather than fabricating a plugin code.

The public Search schema exposes the documented literal source shapes; this scope does not add a regex or discovery method, and the catalog's regex advice is bounded by the existing portable backend contract.
Mutation fixtures verify bounded repair semantics and preservation of failure/completeness evidence, not human-agent success rates or broad repository corpus completeness.

The owning-repository suite retained existing restore, package-vulnerability, XML-documentation, nullability and analyzer warnings; no warning was introduced by the Search build, which passed with -warnaserror.
No package was published, pushed, released or installed, and no sibling repository was edited.
